title: 3112. Minimum Time to Visit Disappearing Nodes

examples.explanation: We are starting our journey from node 0, and our goal is to find the minimum time required to reach each node before it disappears. For node 0, we don't need any time as it is our starting point. For node 1, we need at least 2 units of time to traverse edges[0]. Unfortunately, it disappears at that moment, so we won't be able to visit it. For node 2, we need at least 4 units of time to traverse edges[2].
